The current direct PokerStars Sports France three-way set is 1.05 / 21.00 / 9.50; its no-vig Cieslak fair is +950 versus +850. Oddschecker shows +900 as a cross-book aggregator reference, not an executable price. Sports Interaction Canada separately displays Cieslak +650 in a two-way market; that excludes the draw and cannot be compared with the three-way +950 fair. No Canadian direct three-way quote was confirmed. The available three-way price remains below fair; PASS.
